source_summary: The pattern uses ctx['BUILD_DIR'] which appears to be the application build directory. The .bp-config directory within BUILD_DIR contains build configuration files.
sink_summary: The filtering rule excludes files from being copied/moved to the web deployment directory (WEBDIR) when setting up a web application. Files matching the pattern are not deployed to the web server.
guard_summary: The filtering occurs only for web applications (when WEB_SERVER != 'none'). Multiple exclusion patterns protect configuration files (.bp, .extensions, .bp-config, manifest.yml, LIBDIR) from web deployment. The FileUtil class applies regex pattern matching to filter files.
risk_pattern: Modified exclusion pattern for .bp-config directory in web deployment filtering. The change adds an additional security control to prevent configuration files from being exposed via web server.
context_summary: The function sets up web directory for PHP applications by copying files from BUILD_DIR to WEBDIR, excluding sensitive configuration directories and files using regex patterns. The change adds .bp-config to the exclusion list.
